name: Phone Cleaner: Clean Up Photos
subtitle: Duplicate Photo & Video Finder
promotionalText: Find duplicate photos, similar shots, old screenshots and large videos. Swipe to keep or delete, and see exactly how much photo storage you free up.
description:
Phone Cleaner helps you free up photo and video storage on your iPhone. It finds duplicate photos, similar shots, screenshots and large videos, so you can decide what to keep and delete the rest in a few taps.

DUPLICATES
Copies of the same picture are grouped together. The best one (a favorite, or the highest resolution) is marked to keep, and the extra copies are selected for you.

SIMILAR PHOTOS
Bursts and near-identical shots taken moments apart are grouped so you can keep your favorite and clear the rest.

SCREENSHOTS AND LARGE VIDEOS
See every screenshot in one place, and your biggest videos sorted by size.

SWIPE TO CLEAN
Go through your library one photo at a time. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep, and undo any choice. Review everything you marked before anything is deleted.

SEE THE SPACE YOU FREE
Phone Cleaner shows the storage freed by every cleanup and keeps a running total.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Photos are analyzed on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework. Nothing is uploaded, and there are no accounts, ads or tracking.

SAFE DELETING
Nothing is deleted until you choose it and confirm. Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in the Photos app, where you can recover them for 30 days.

Phone Cleaner works with the photos and videos in your library. It doesn't change your iPhone's performance, battery life or other apps.

PHONE CLEANER PREMIUM
Scanning, the cleanup lists and Swipe to Clean are free, and the free plan deletes up to 20 items a day. Premium removes the daily limit.
• Weekly: $4.99 per week
• Yearly: $29.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
Prices are in US dollars and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://jimtarfas.github.io/phone-cleaner-site/privacy.html
reviewNotes:
Phone Cleaner scans the photo library on the device (Apple Vision feature prints) to find duplicates, similar shots, screenshots and large videos, and deletes only what the user selects. Every deletion goes through the system confirmation and lands in Recently Deleted.

To test: allow photo access, then open Duplicates, Similar Photos, Screenshots, Large Videos or Swipe to Clean. A library with a few duplicated photos gives the best results.

Subscriptions: the Premium screen opens once after the first launch and from the crown button on the home screen; it also opens when the free plan's 20 deletions per day are used up. It shows both plans with full pricing, the 3-day free trial on the yearly plan, Restore Purchases, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. No account or login is needed.

The app makes no claims about speeding up the device; it only frees photo and video storage.
